WazirX is an Indian cryptocurrency exchange providing REST and WebSocket APIs for spot trading on INR and crypto markets. The API supports order management, market data retrieval, account management, wallet operations, and sub-account management. Authentication uses HMAC SHA256 signatures for signed endpoints.
